what: When a piece becomes visible it enters from 40px away, tilted (above/below ±5°, side/diagonal ±10°), snapping into place in five steps over .6s with steps(5) — stop-motion like moving paper cutouts one cell at a time

options.rotate: Initial tilt (degrees) per default direction (down 5, up −5, left −10, right 10) — 0 means no tilt
options.dur: Duration (sec), default .6 — a title coming in from the left on Brand is 1
options.at: Visible ratio needed to start, default .1
options.look: swing: Brand character type — each step (each seconds) tilts alternately by rot±swing and grows s0→1 from outside its own size % (ox·oy) into place. The first step is invisible, fires fx:done when finished
options.each: look: swing duration per step (sec), default .4
options.swing: look: swing alternating tilt angle (deg), default 15
options.ox: look: swing initial horizontal offset (% of its own width), default 0
options.oy: look: swing — initial vertical offset (% of its own height), default 0
options.on: If load, it starts as soon as it is attached (after delay) without waiting to be visible

note: Caught by IntersectionObserver even when the board, not the window, moves via transform (use together with zoom-pan-board)
